activity.notes: Apoena was a Xavante chief of the Pimentel Barbosa community. Scholarly accounts document his contact strategy around 1950–1951 and his continued leadership into the late 1970s and early 1980s, when he sent younger Xavante to learn Portuguese and Brazilian institutions. The interval is a representative evidence window, not a formal reign.

sources.title: Contact Strategies: Histories of Native Autonomy in Brazil
sources.citation_text: The historical study describes Chief Apoena's peace/contact strategy from the 1940s and his leadership decisions into the late 1970s and early 1980s.
